notes.title: Fixed Attract Audio crash, and Attract audio limit and more!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/2530244d70932895793cecfca6e31e17fcd75475.png
Dear Neon Fanatics,

We have some awesome stuff planned for Neon in the future, but for now, here are a few fixes here and there. Enjoy!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/cc46c02219f29511408d93f6ae4992cdfa59c81b.png
Major Fixes: Press the HOME button to reload all custom textures in the game instantly. Also increased texture load times for custom artwork.

Fixed Attract Audio crash, and Attract audio limit. Also improved load times and memory usage of Attract Audio files.

Moderate Fixes:
Radio volume can be adjusted with the console command: nra.RadioVolume

Minor Fixes:
Special and Lightgun Arcades can now be tested correctly in the Arcade Preview Map.

ArcadeMachineDisabled has been added to the Arcade Builder and can now be customised.

Misc Fixes:
Genesis / Mega Drive Emulators working on Windows 10 due to PicoDrive emulator update.

FPS Cabinets are now in the correct order in the Arcade Builder.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/d4e054bff9d2bd5b850908bac3d39d146105f7c4.png

On a side note, we have a lovely Discord Channel for NRA:N that you may wish to participate in. The community is active and you’ll often see us jumping into chats. Hopefully see you there!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/58667ad719b8ba0a3df08b833b5369c9e3944520.png

Thanks so much for the support. – Joe

Best regards,
Digital Cybercherries Ltd.

notes.title: Created new and improved Arcade Builder tool!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/1d9a6c76b618b8d7b4564d388959a3cb833469be.png
Dear Retro Fans,

For those who missed it, please take a look at our previous announcement which goes into detail with what we’ve recently been up to: http://steamcommunity.com/games/465780/announcements/detail/1471979126291199601
Well, we promised you we are still here and have been working on Neon. Santa has arrived early with a nice gift for you: New and improved Arcade Builder tool with new system for customising your perfect Arcade and more!


Here are the latest patch notes:
Fixed Color setting for console cartridges didn't work.
Fixed  GameBro backlight enabled by default.
Fixed  Special Cabinet screens aren't aligned properly which lead to pixel bleed.

Added missing formats.
Added New Radio Stations for Boombox.
Added Launch Options into map (Classic, Neon) for the Arcade Builder .
Added Asynchronous Texture Streaming System for faster Texture and Level loading.

Created new and improved Arcade Builder tool.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/616aec7c3809b64917a386c25583742353160087.png
This new Arcade Builder works with the new Arcade format used in Neon to improve usage with multiple custom arcades and content.

Check out the tools button on the top bar to begin importing and fixing legacy-arcade format XML files to work with the new format.

Create a layout from the heading on the left to specify the locations of each arcade or cartridge in the map.

You can drag and drop nodes from the list onto the layout map itself, or onto the list of nodes on the right.

Also, you can right click on nodes or tabs to find more options. 

(More information about New Arcade Builder tool below:)
[code]New Features:
Arcade Layout System - Create a Layout which specifies the location of your custom arcades within the environment. (Instead of one entire template for the whole arcade)

Legacy Import Tools  - Import your old arcades from the old XML format to the new JSON format, they can then be used in your custom Layouts.

Tabs  - You can edit multiple peices of content at once with a more intuative and tab-based interface.

Audio Previews - You can preview your audio files for Attract Screens or Tapes within the builder.

Texture Previews - You can now preview textures in any supported format, within the builder.

Filters - You can use filters to help narrow down a large list of user content to a specific game or platform.

Themes  - Some people want a more professional and clean interface, we have the option for them!

Please note this version is still a work in progress, certain features may not be fully implemented at the moment.[/code]
        

We hope you have an amazing festive break and enjoy your time off with family and friends. Bring on 2018!

Have fun in-game! - Joe

Warmest Regards & Festive Cheers,
Digital Cybercherries Ltd.

notes.title: Message to our Community
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

So, I know things have been very quiet at our end and now that most of the dust has settled, I’d like to briefly explain what has been going on.

Unfortunately, within our team, and due to unforeseen circumstances, we’ve had some major restructuring. This involved some of our beloved members venturing onto new things. We wish them the best of luck and cannot explain how thankful we are for all their hard work and dedication to our projects.

I can appreciate it may seem very unusual for us to be this inactive in terms of communication with you all, especially in view of how responsive and transparent we usually are. It was never our intention for this to happen. 

Most of you probably do not know, but Digital Cybercherries consists of only a small team, (even smaller now,) and we do not have an actual studio. We all work from home and some developers are in different countries. In fact, many of us work full-time jobs to keep development prosperous and healthy. We simply have not made enough funding in order to develop both NRA:N and HYPERCHARGE: Unboxed full time.

We originally set up Digital Cybercherries as a group of close-friends with the sole purpose of being able to create awesome and entertaining content. Our dream was, and still is, to eventually have enough finances to work from our own studio and be able to make and develop games full time. An enormous amount of effort has gone into this goal. Don’t get us wrong, it’s not all about money. We develop games because we love to do it, it’s our passion. But at the same time we have to be realistic. Without enough funding we cannot keep up with the strains of continuous work. 

Looking back now, maybe we were not honest enough with you regarding our current situation / set-up. We wanted DCC to be perceived as a Triple-A studio, even though technically, we never had a studio, just a virtual one. Everything we have done, from development to communication was with the intention of being perfect, to every fine detail. But as life goes, it’s simply not possible to maintain such a mindset given our position.

Right, onto a more positive note:

Have we still been developing HYPERCHARGE: Unboxed?
Yes, we haven’t stopped working on it.

When is the next update for HYPERCHARGE: Unboxed?
Due to planning and major restructuring within the team, I cannot now give an honest answer. I promise I will keep you updated regarding this.

Have you abandoned New Retro Arcade: Neon?
Definitely not.

Have we still been developing New Retro Arcade Neon?
We have done little bits here and there.  Once planning has been fully established, we’ll start updating Neon.

I’m not making excuses for us, but rather, valid reasons. There is heart and honesty in this post. I wanted to be fully honest with you guys. There has been a lot going on development wise as well as within our team which I won’t go fully into. Sometimes it's not all what it seems from a player's perspective. Things are always more complicated than you may believe. Once we have a solid foundation within our team and planning, we’ll get back to the good ol`days of regular updates. 

You’ll see a lot of positive changes in 2018. After all our obstacles and hindrances, we will not give up. We believe in ourselves and the passion our fans provide. We certainly won’t give up on you. 

We’re utterly sorry for the lack of communication and any inconvenience we may have caused.

To those who have stuck by us since day 1, we thank you from the bottom of our hearts. You will be kept up to date with our plans. I ask that you trust in our word and continue to walk with us on our journey. We’re not going anywhere. - Joe

With love,
Digital Cybecherries Ltd. X

notes.title: Added LightGun support! - Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
Dear Arcade Goer’s,

As you know, we constantly monitor your feedback and really listen to what it is you are saying. On that note, the festive season has come early and we welcome you with a gift; LightGun support!

If you require help calibrating your LightGun games, please see the LightGun set-up section in the Arcade Builder Guide below: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=736005082
From everyone at DCC, we sincerely hope you have a fantastic Festive holiday. Be safe and have fun.  For the next couple of weeks, we may be a little slower with responding and releasing updates as we will be visiting family and friends, but don’t worry, we’ll be back in full force soon enough.

Find out the current status of development by visiting our Trello support board below:
https://trello.com/b/xc1WU1Fx/newretroarcade-neon-support

Here are the latest patch notes:
Added -debugLightgun as a launch option so you can trace the center of the LightGun cabinet screen for calibration. (You may need to disable Multi Res Shading)

Added nra.LightgunCalibrationX and nra.LightgunCalibrationY as console commands. (See Arcade Builder Guide for explanation on how to use this command)

Added –ArcadeMachines – Example: (-ArcadeMachines=arcade2.xml) This launch option allows users to have multiple xml files for different Arcade set-ups. 

Added fallback option if in case there is no xml file present for the Arcade machines.

Your Community Manager Joe and the rest of The Digital Cybercherries team.

notes.title: Added Oculus Touch Improvements!
notes.content:
Dear VR friends,

Today we release a few Oculus Touch improvements as well as having the privilege of announcing our new title we are working on; HYPERCHARGE: Unboxed - A co-op FPS game.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/97e25c525ff53e445b6cd35e7fa3a78b1ae94620.png
It's the final push. With only 24 hours left to vote for New Retro Arcade: Neon at the VRDB Awards, please ask friends and family to vote too. Thank you to everyone so much who have voted and who are continuing to spread the word. We can win this! http://www.vrdb.com/groups/2016-vr-of-the-year-awards/top50#vote50776

Find out the current status of development by visiting our Trello support board below:
https://trello.com/b/xc1WU1Fx/newretroarcade-neon-support

Here are the latest patch notes:
Added ability to use the right thumbstick to rotate the player using Touch Controllers.¹
Added ability to disable auto-setting of Oculus sound device, can let windows default device work instead.²
Added ability to change player turn speed using the config files.³
Fixed Startup command "-vrseated" now uses standard gamepad control scheme with no motion controllers.

¹ Player must be inside the movement circle, same as using slide-locomotion with left thumbstick.
² Add bUseDefaultAudioDevice=True to GameUserSettings.ini
³ Add PlayerTurnSpeed=166 to your 1GameUserSettings.ini. Note: Value is half as slow when using VR.)

Your Community Manager Joe and the rest of The Digital Cybercherries team.

notes.title: Oculus Touch support now added!
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/heeBPNj.gif
View full size version here.

Dear Retro lovers,

As the title states, we have now added official support for the Oculus Touch controllers! But it doesn’t end there; support for local multiplayer has also been implemented, (so you can use two controllers on 1 machine) as well as many various fixes and tweaks. Because of your feedback and continued support, New Retro Arcade: Neon is truly turning into something amazing, thank you all so much.

While I have got you all here, the folks over at VRDB.com are hosting their first ever VR of the Year Awards. For those who absolutely love New Retro Arcade: Neon, (or even just like it) we would be honored if you would vote for the game. You can vote by visiting our page below: 

http://www.vrdb.com/games/new-retro-arcade-neon

Help spread the word by sharing with your friends & family. Let's do this!

You can see the current status of development by visiting our Trello support board below:
https://trello.com/b/xc1WU1Fx/newretroarcade-neon-support

Here are the latest patch notes:



Added official support for Oculus Touch controllers.

Fixed the game sound not coming through the Rift headphones when launched in Oculus VR mode. The game should now output sound from the Rift headphones by default.
Added support for local multiplayer. Multiplayer games (2-4 Players) should now allow for multiple input devices to register and play on a single machine.
Fixed Sliding Locomotion circle appearing when playing Arcades, Consoles or Gamebros.
Fixed Game Console and Gamebro buttons being mapped incorrectly.
Fixed Gamebro screen being miss-aligned, this should now be much more accurate.
Fixed ‘Revert to Default’ button in the keybindings not resetting controls properly. 
Fixed the Mip stream settings for various newspaper assets, these should now be high res.
Fixed the LOD setting on the entrance ‘Coming Soon’ posters, these should now be high res when entering the arcade.
Fixed the location of a few Cassette tapes slightly to avoid them falling into objects.
Fixed the location of a Games Cartridge in the VIP room which would fall through the shelving.
Fixed the location of the Drum Machine to be correctly aligned with the couch.

Your Community Manager Joe and the rest of The Digital Cybercherries team.

Libretro cores should now output their internal core parameter options
Added “ArcadeEmulatorOptions.xml” for overriding or adding core specific options, such as enabling cheats, throttle or boot to OSD. Example below:

Fixed missing screen-space reflections in Classic map.

Fixed a gap in the arcade walls which leaked into the void.

notes.title: Added support for video attract screens & more!
notes.content:
Dear Community,

We hope you enjoy the recent updates and as always, we are monitoring feedback from our forums and social media. Thank you for all of your suggestions, keep them coming! Also, for those who may be new or have not yet seen, be sure to check out the Official Arcade Builder Guide below:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=736005082
It will walk you through the Arcade Builder application and more. If you do require any further help please contact support@digitalcybercherries.com or create a post on our forums / social media. 

Do not be afraid to ask for help. As many of you know, we are very active in terms of interaction with the community, but I would like to point out our community itself is extremely friendly and helpful towards others. We sincerely thank you for this and we encourage you to keep helping other players.

Find out the current status of development by visiting our Trello support board below:
https://trello.com/b/xc1WU1Fx/newretroarcade-neon-support

Added support for video attract screens, this is default to .mp4 (you can change the format by editing the GameUserSettings.ini and finding the line 'AttractMovie=AttractScreens.mp4']
Added  support for VIVE 'Slide' locomotion. The left motion controller is used for walk movement, the right controller is now for teleport.
Added  music tracks to the credits.
Added  various sounds around the arcade including hat impacts and footstep surface tweaks.
Adjusted  throw velocity for bowling balls.


Your Community Manager Joe & the rest of the Digital Cybercherries team.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES #04 – Huge update - Bar area added & much more!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/24fee9afeb817a79b1befdf7387665477f7e6c74.png
Bar area now added to Neon.
	
Dear Community,

It's been nearly 2 weeks since the release of New Retro Arcade: Neon and what a couple of weeks it has been. As many of you will already know, the launch did not go as smoothly as it could have. Our attempt to add additional content at the last minute led to unexpected issues arising. Some features were not fully functional and others did not meet expectations.

We are truly grateful that the community has rallied around us and been so supportive as we work to improve and expand the experience. The understanding the community has shown, even throughout this bumpy start, means the world to us. 

We will continue working hard to update the game; we have already released many fixes and patches, as well as taking on board all feedback. To show our appreciation our art team has been expanding the Arcade, even as the coders rectify the issues. It’s been a long couple of weeks with some very late nights, but finally we’re proud to announce that the Arcade Bar is now open!

With your continued support, we can and will make New Retro Arcade: Neon one of the best VR games. Thank you.
 
As I mention quite a lot, we have a Trello support board which gives you the ability to view the current status of development. See more below:

https://trello.com/b/xc1WU1Fx/newretroarcade-neon-support


Here are the latest patch notes:




 Added Bar Area to Neon map. Added games console trigger input, right trigger should no longer press 'B'.
  Added  more Arcade Cabinets, Gamebros & VHS Tapes to maps.
 
 Added map overviews to the ArcadeBuilder with item locations.  Added  fixed Prompt system for controllers. (This will not affect your current XML files. To configure the additional cabinets and VHS Tapes in the Builder, you will need to revert to the new .defaults files or edit your existing XMLs to include the new items.)

 Added  Added VoIP prompt system. (See the options menu for your default key.)
 Added  Added customizable VHS Tape labels.
 Added  Added support for DualShock4.

Fixed multiplayer servers not properly ending sessions.
Fixed Keybinding locking up the screen.
Fixed controller prompts, these should now be displayed correctly.
Fixed Bowling Alley scoring and sounds.
Fixed Boxing Machine hit detection for motion controllers.
Fixed stat based achivements not correctly registering.
Fixed Server Hosts hearing multiple flashlight sounds. 

Updated the Projector networking to increase stability and added a video quality override for lower speed connections. To enable lower quality video simply add the following text to your steam launch option: -lowvideotest.

 Added  High Quality Audio Tracks for the Soundtrack (Files are now available as FLAC)
 Added  5 Playalong Audio Tracks for the guitar (sorted by different skill levels):

You can download them by visiting the link below:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/1357989/NRAN%20Playbacks.zip



Thank you so much for sticking by us. As our slogan states; we are Powered By You.

Your Community Manager Joe and the rest of The Digital Cybercherries team.
